import clr,json
clr.AddReference('Grasshopper')
import Grasshopper as GH
r={'enable_solutions':GH.Kernel.GH_Document.EnableSolutions,'documents':[]}
for d in GH.Instances.DocumentServer:
 r['documents'].append({'path':d.FilePath,'enabled':d.Enabled,'solution_state':str(d.SolutionState),'objects':[{'name':o.Name,'phase':str(o.Phase),'type':str(o.GetType())} for o in d.Objects if isinstance(o,GH.Kernel.IGH_Component)]})
print(json.dumps(r))
